skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Shining Dew SD08
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Shining Dew Series SD08. Tight-fitting, lightweight, breathable, and designed for the summer.
skins.quote: Sandstorms should be no blanket presence this season, so she's curbing her temper for the time being and making friends with the tame pools of water. It's a fair thing, all told.

skins.name: Hohenlohe Chillysand
skins.content: Carnelian's winter outfit in Leithanien / Hohenlohe Chillysand. A traditional Leithanian women's trenchcoat with a pair of animal skin shawls and fleece gloves. Fear not the cold.
skins.quote: Hailing from a fiery country, a heart of boiling blood mixed with the frigid cold. When wind and snow meet, all must seek safe haven.
